name: Local Intros
description: Select a flashy pre-roll from local storage to run before any video content. The video details are loaded from disk after a video is played from the library from the beginning of the video. A random video is selected, and all videos in the local directory are enabled by default. Specific videos can be enabled or disabled as necessary. After videos are loaded for the first time, additional videos found in the directory are not enabled by default.
overview: Display flashy intros before movies and other videos

versions.changelog:
- Rebuilt rules engine: one rule per intro video (media type, tags, ratings, users, frequency weight)
- Removed legacy Genre/Studio/Date-range rules and Precedence in favor of the new per-video rules
- Added admin-managed per-user opt-out (disable intros entirely for specific users)

versions.changelog: - Behavior change: per-video "Users" field now EXCLUDES the selected users instead of restricting to them. Empty means no exclusions (everyone eligible); a checked user will never see that specific intro.

- Added Preview: play any intro clip in an overlay without leaving the config page
- Added plugin thumbnail for the catalog listing
- Fix: MediaType now uses the string enum values Jellyfin's API actually returns (was using numeric values, causing a crash on load)
